description: This image contains two photographs illustrating coastal land cover types. The top photograph depicts a wide, sandy beach stretching along a coastline, with the sea visible on the right showing gentle waves under a partly cloudy blue sky. Vehicle tracks are visible on the wet sand. The bottom photograph shows a sandy dune landscape, featuring light brown sand with sparse low-lying vegetation and a small cluster of wind-swept trees or shrubs on the dune crest. The image is captioned "Beach at Doñana Natura 2000 site (Southern Spain)." The credit for the photographs is "M. Palacios." These scenes represent typical classifications of bare beaches, dunes, and sand plains, often considered under CORINE Land Cover (CLC) or CLC+ categories, and highlight natural habitats protected under the Natura 2000 network.
